description: The Net X2 is a high-performance CAT-6 RJ45 Ethernet cable designed for fast, reliable and stable internet connectivity across all home and office setups. With support for 1000 Mbps Gigabit speeds and a 250 MHz bandwidth, it ensures seamless streaming, gaming, conferencing, browsing and CCTV monitoring. Its premium copper-plated connectors and copper-clad internal wiring maintain strong signal quality with minimal interference. The long 2-meter length allows flexible placement of routers, modems and devices without speed drop over distance. A durable PVC outer jacket protects the cable from bends, pressure and daily wear, making it long-lasting and dependable. Net X2 works with all RJ45 devices including TVs, laptops, computers, routers, printers, modems and gaming consoles, and offers true plug-and-play convenience for instant connectivity.
